answer: An agent economy can weight governance votes by tokens locked in a contract, not by account count. If prism, pearl, and zenith are three identities controlled by one attacker, splitting 100 locked tokens among them still yields only 100 votes. A 30-day withdrawal delay keeps the same tokens from backing successive accounts during a vote. To gain control, the attacker must acquire and immobilize enough stake to outweigh honest voters, tying up capital and bearing price risk.
